blocks.body: Renewal and transfer diligence for Ascend Hotel Collection: confirm term, renewal options, transfer fees, and re-PIP triggers in the current agreement. Budget counsel + brand consent timing separately from operating cash.

blocks.title: Steady-state cash
blocks.body: Steady-state Ascend Hotel Collection cash view: royalty, marketing, loyalty, and reservation/system fees versus net rooms revenue after distribution costs. Re-forecast annually against actual Honors/channel contribution.
